tools.name: search
tools.description: Free-text search over Foodeist restaurants. Understands "<cuisine or name> in <city>" ("best tacos in Austin", "Joe's Pizza in New York") and plain restaurant names. Returns ids to pass to fetch. Prefer top_restaurants / search_restaurants when you can fill their fields.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text profile of one restaurant (details, hours, review summary, menu highlights) by the id that search returned.

tools.name: find_cities
tools.description: Look up cities Foodeist covers by name. Use it to disambiguate ("Portland" → Oregon or Maine) and get the slug for other tools.

tools.name: top_restaurants
tools.description: Best-ranked restaurants in a city by the Foodeist ranking, optionally only one cuisine. Answers "best X in Y" questions.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Find restaurants by (part of) their name, optionally inside one city. Use for "is X any good", "what time does X close".

tools.name: restaurants_nearby
tools.description: Restaurants around coordinates, best first (or nearest first). Use when the user gives a location, address you can geocode, or "near me" with coordinates.

tools.name: get_restaurant
tools.description: Everything Foodeist knows about one restaurant: address, phone, website, ratings by source, price level, cuisines, weekly hours and open-now, delivery services, description, what reviewers praise and complain about, menu sections.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Menu of one restaurant: sections, dishes, prices, descriptions. Filter by a section or dish keyword to keep it short.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
